title: Olympus IX73 inverted microscope
manualMd: Inverted phase-contrast microscope used for cell-culture inspection and live-cell imaging. Objectives: 4×, 10×, 20× ph, 40× ph. Camera mount supports a Hamamatsu CMOS for fluorescence work.
hazardsMd:
- Mercury / fluorescence lamps reach high temperature; wait 15 min after switching off before re-igniting.
- UV channel: never look directly at the field with UV illumination on.

operations.title: Daily startup
operations.bodyMd: Power on the body, then the lamp. Confirm the phase ring on the condenser matches the objective in use. Wait 5 min for the lamp to stabilize before imaging.

operations.title: Köhler illumination
operations.bodyMd:
1. Focus on a sample at 10×.
2. Close the field diaphragm until you see the polygon edges.
3. Focus the condenser until the edges are crisp.
4. Center with the condenser-centering screws.
5. Open the field diaphragm to just outside the field of view.
Köhler must be re-set at every objective change.

operations.title: Cells out of focus / blurry
operations.bodyMd: Check (a) the objective phase ring matches your phase setting, (b) the condenser is at the right working distance for the dish, (c) the dish bottom is glass or thin plastic — thick plastic ruins phase contrast.

operations.title: Lamp won't ignite
operations.bodyMd: If hot from a recent run, wait 15 min. If still won't strike, the bulb may be at end-of-life (typical 200 hours).

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd: Remove your sample. Lower the stage. Wipe any spilled medium. Switch lamp off; leave the body powered for 5 min before turning off so the cooling fan can run.
